name: print-social-sticker-collage-carousel-cover
title: Hot-pink sticker-collage carousel cover
whatItIs: A 4:5 portrait Instagram carousel cover on flat hot pink. A huge extended white sans headline stacks over a delicate white script word. Cut-out photos with thick white outlines (cherries, a heart padlock, a woman sipping iced coffee) are scattered like stickers, with white hand-drawn squiggles and a tilted black label. A black footer band holds an outlined handle pill. A faint tiled repeat of the account name sits behind everything.
whatItMeans: It is loud, flirty and instantly scroll-stopping, with the feel of a teen's scrapbook or a magazine cover. The pink is bold, the black adds punch, and the sticker objects add personality and a little wit. The mix of elegant script and heavy sans says 'soft but confident'.
techniques: Pair a delicate script word with a massive extended sans headline for strong contrast in mood and weight.
Cut out photos and objects and give them a thick white outline so they read as stickers on the flat colour.
Scatter the stickers unevenly and overlap the headline slightly, so the composition feels hand-made and lively.
Add hand-drawn white squiggles and crowns as gestural accents that echo the script type.
Tilt one black label a few degrees to break the grid and hold the secondary line of text.
Use a single saturated background with black and white only, letting the photos supply the extra colour.
Repeat the account name as a very faint tiled pattern behind everything for branding without clutter.
Anchor the layout with a black footer band and an outlined pill holding the handle.
bestFor: Instagram and TikTok carousels, especially lifestyle, beauty and fashion content
Youth-oriented or feminine-leaning brands and creators
Posters, event flyers and zine covers that want a sticker-scrapbook feel

vocabulary.definition: An image with the background removed and a thick contrasting outline, so it looks like a die-cut sticker.
A grotesque typeface with wide letterforms, giving a bold, modern feel at large sizes.
Pairing a flowing calligraphic word with a heavy sans to create hierarchy and personality.
The first slide of a swipeable social post, designed to stop the scroll and promise what follows.
Hand-drawn lines or shapes added over a layout to make it feel human and informal.
A very low-contrast repeated text or shape in the background, adding texture without competing.
